## Ask your question here

`接口+分组+版本号才能唯一确定一个服务`
那QoS里invoke，的语法是什么？

`invoke 类.方法()` (里面没 分组和版本)
hints_text:
If you only pulish one service for one interface, just use `invoke className.methodName()`

If there are more than one service for one interface, use `cd serviceKey` first.
@AlbumenJ `dubbo version "3.0.5"`
